title: Lambda fails with Cannot find module 'aws-sdk' after moving to a newer Node.js runtime
symptoms: Code that ran on nodejs16.x breaks right after switching the runtime
require('aws-sdk') works locally but not in the deployed function
cause: Every supported Lambda Node.js runtime ships only SDK for JavaScript v3, not v2. Code that relied on the runtime providing aws-sdk v2 has nothing to load.
fix: Port the calls to the modular v3 clients and bundle the clients you use in the deployment package rather than relying on the runtime copy.
affected: Lambda nodejs18.x and every later Node.js runtime (currently nodejs22.x, nodejs24.x, nodejs26.x)
